title: Three-Dimensional Reconstruction of a CT Image under Deep Learning Algorithm to Evaluate the Application of Percutaneous Kyphoplasty in Osteoporotic Thoracolumbar Compression Fractures.
summary: An improved V-Net reconstructed CT vertebrae for measuring height and kyphosis in a specific PKP-versus-PVP study of osteoporotic compression fractures. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
ai_technology: The learned V-Net segments/reconstructs CT vertebrae; Dice and Hausdorff metrics compare the improved network with U-Net, V-Net, and CNN.
